payload.reason: The dataset was collected from multiple sources, including the Common Voice corpus and Tatoeba, with a focus on ensuring speaker diversity and quality of translations.

claims.text: The CoVoST dataset was created using validated speech samples from the Common Voice corpus, which includes recordings from multiple speakers and accents.
An evaluation set was constructed from Tatoeba, filtering for quality and sentence length to ensure real-world applicability.
The dataset includes contributions from over 11,000 speakers across 11 languages, ensuring a diverse representation.
